Perhaps we have been the unfortunate ones. I have been a head count with the surgery practice for 3 decades in need of little medical attention. I personally believe in self-care.

Last December I was asked to have some blood tests to comply with the monitoring under NHS funding arrangement for diabetic screening. Having had the blood test a month ago, one of the blood test results did not come back and is still missing. In between time I had not been contacted by phlebotomy clinic nor anyone to attend another appointment.

In the last month, I spent a lot of time checking through my NHS app on the test results. I tried twice to chase up the missing result: first by checking with the receptionist on the phone. Then I waited another week to make a trip to the surgery just to find out what happened. All was said to keep on waiting!

By 4th May, I delivered  a letter addressed to the GP who reviewed the rest of my test results, asking for a response to the matter and their decision on the next action:  a re-test or the blood test result was finally traced.

Yesterday was Friday 9th May. I have had no acknowledgement of my request nor a response whatsoever.

The helpful NHS app allows me to see that my letter was logged on as received. This specific blood test was clearly shown “to follow” on the day the blood was taken.

I don’t feel my persistent action to follow up about my health in the 4 weeks is unjustified. Now, it is no longer of concern.

If health were meant to be checked thoroughly, then it must be adhered to properly.

The whole process prompted me to share my experience. Often the reality deviates from the principles or objectives laid down.

Be realistic and believe in the situation.",null,[0,231]]]],[null,1747063162000000,1747063162000000,"10 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/6219280332504056356/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZRYlRod2RsZGtjMTgyU0ZCQkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/6219280332504056356/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZRYlRod2RsZGtjMTgyU0ZCQkVBRRAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/6219280332504056356/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZRYlRod2RsZGtjMTgyU0ZCQkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/6219280332504056356/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZRYlRod2RsZGtjMTgyU0ZCQkVBRRAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/6219280332504056356/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZRYlRod2RsZGtjMTgyU0ZCQkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/6219280332504056356/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZRYlRod2RsZGtjMTgyU0ZCQkVBRRAA"],null,["en"],[["Thank you for your feedback.
